method.method_draft: Read the top row as the initial order 1,3,5,4,2 and the bottom row/text as the target order 1,2,3,4,5. Compare positions: cards 1 and 4 are already correct; cards 2, 3, and 5 form a cycle of wrong positions: position 2 contains 3, position 3 contains 5, position 5 contains 2. Use the permutation rule that a cycle of length k can be fixed in k-1 arbitrary swaps. The 3-cycle therefore needs 2 swaps, so the minimum is 2.
